div.h5: How to set up Instagram via Facebook App

ol.li: Instagram uses Facebook's Graph API — you must set up Facebook first (see Facebook Developer Account settings above)

Once your Facebook App is created, add these products in the App Dashboard:
Instagram Graph API (for posting, comments, media)
Instagram Basic Display (for profile data)
Convert your Instagram account to a Business or Creator account (Settings → Account → Switch to Professional Account)
Link your Instagram Business account to a Facebook Page (Facebook Page Settings → Linked Accounts → Instagram)
Copy the same Facebook App ID and App Secret here

To find your Instagram Business Account ID:
→ Go to Graph API Explorer
→ Select your app → GET /me/accounts?fields=instagram_business_account
→ Copy the instagram_business_account.id value and paste it into your Instagram account's Instagram Business Account ID field
Generate an access token with: instagram_basic, instagram_content_publish, instagram_manage_comments, instagram_manage_messages
For inbox/messaging: also enable Pages Messaging product in your Facebook App

div.p: Important: Instagram API requires Facebook App Review and Business Verification for most permissions. Content publishing via API is limited to Business/Creator accounts only — personal accounts are not supported.
